_comment: Brand-tied fuel-discount presets. Bundled for the demo; in production this is fetched once on launch from a small REMOTE JSON so base rates update without a new build (the ONLY fetch that makes sense — the shared catalog, never the user's personal cards). Rates are user-editable client-side; 'cents' is the default. 'premium' (P95/P98) overrides 'cents' for premium fuels where a program differs. Brand strings match FuelCheck's brand field. flybuys maps to Reddy Express ONLY (the former Coles Express network) — NOT generic Shell, which would over-claim.
